blocks.t: Measuring an initial rate involves determining small changes in concentration D[A] that occur during a short time interval Dt. Sometimes it can be difficult to obtain sufficiently precise experimental data for these small changes. An alternative is to use an ­integrated rate law, which expresses the concentration of a species directly as a function of the time. For any simple rate expression, a corresponding inte­ grated rate law can be obtained.
